purpose: Prospective validation of frozen CEREBRON-A1-CANDIDATE against A0 under matched resources on unseen seeds and unseen target families.
candidate_model_library_rule: Fixed generic observable-only basis library shared identically by A0 and A1; no family label supplied to selector.

required: A1 mean MAE < A0 mean MAE
A1 wins at least 5 of 7 seeds
no heldout family has A1 MAE > A0 MAE by more than 5 percent

failure_rule: If any required prospective criterion fails, do not promote A1. Record the residual and return to development without changing BENCH-004 outcomes.
claim_limit: Passing BENCH-004 would validate only this synthetic orchestration-weight change under the preregistered harness. It would not establish AGI, superintelligence, neural-weight learning, or general external transfer.
